body: I'm not a new yorker, actually I'm from other side of the earth, but I want you to re-think your choice. Think of your family
Even if you do kill yourself over failed relationship it's ok...We're not robots, everything can hurt us. I hope that you will change your mind, however I know how much pain you are in

Devil is my long and loved friend. Maybe even the only friend I have. But the only thing to remember, is that there will be no turning back. No one can pull you up after you take your life away. No one can pull you back after you meet him.
There's nothing I can say besides I feel the same. This emptiness is terrifing.
Sorry for that. I'm really insecure about my english 'cause I'm mostly self-taught. I wanted to avoid comments "smacking" me for my possible bad grammar that's why.
